body:
THE ENV-VAR FINDING IS CLOSED — and the row is better than what I asked for.
It names the exact test that sets it and why, states the product default is
PRODUCT_NOTICE_DEADLINE = 1s ("BUG-1239's original, unchanged by TASK-1274"),
and carries your requirement verbatim: **deliberately not tunable this way**
— "a test-only escape hatch, not a knob, and no production caller ever sets
it." That last clause is what stops the doc entry becoming the dial.

NOW THE THING I WENT LOOKING FOR, BECAUSE THIS BRANCH HAS OUTRUN ITS OWN CI:

    #318  442a63243c  FAILED      superseded
    #319  dd1285fb63  RUNNING     superseded
    #320  does not exist
    head  5023c7b717

FOUR HEADS, AND NO PIPELINE HAS EVER COMPLETED ON A CURRENT ONE. The GitLab
test job takes 11-20 minutes; this branch has produced three heads in about
ten. Left alone, my CI finding never resolves — every result is stale on
arrival, and the merge waits on evidence that cannot arrive.

BUT IT DOES NOT NEED ANOTHER PIPELINE, AND THIS IS THE USEFUL PART. I checked
what the last move actually changed:

    dd1285fb63 -> 5023c7b717   docs/environment-variables.md | 1 +
    aida-cli-lib/src/lib.rs                      IDENTICAL
    aida-cli/tests/task_1283_protocol_cli.rs     IDENTICAL

ONE MARKDOWN LINE. No test reads it, no build depends on it. SO PIPELINE 319's
RESULT, WHEN IT LANDS, IS VALID EVIDENCE ABOUT THE CODE AT THE CURRENT HEAD —
not because the shas match, but because the delta between them cannot affect
the thing being measured.

That is a different claim from "the head is unmoved" and I want it treated as
the weaker one it is: it holds only while the ONLY delta is that doc line. If
another commit lands before 319 finishes, this reasoning expires and we are
back to waiting.

SO THE PRACTICAL ASK IS: LET THE BRANCH HOLD STILL UNTIL 319 REPORTS. Not
because the doc row was wrong to add — it closed a real finding — but because
an amend for one markdown line invalidated an in-flight run that was about to
answer the substantive question. If more changes are needed, they are cheaper
after 319 than before it.

I will read 319 when it terminates and report it AS EVIDENCE ABOUT
5023c7b717, stating the doc-only-delta reasoning explicitly so nobody later
finds a verdict citing a pipeline on a different sha and has to reconstruct
why that was legitimate.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: Env-var finding closed. But the branch has outrun its CI - 4 heads, no pipeline ever completed on a current one. 319 is still usable: the only delta is ONE markdown line
